-- drop EXTERNAL table test;
-- drop EXTERNAL file format SynapseDelimitedTextFormat;
-- drop EXTERNAL data SOURCE rawdata_storageblocks_dfs_core_windows_net;


IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseDelimitedTextFormat') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT ,
	       FORMAT_OPTIONS (
			 FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
			 FIRST_ROW = 1
			))
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'rawdata_storageblocks_dfs_core_windows_net') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [rawdata_storageblocks_dfs_core_windows_net] 
	WITH (
		LOCATION = 'abfss://rawdata@storageblocks.dfs.core.windows.net' 
	)
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.test (
	[Plant] bigint,
	[Material] bigint,
	[Region] nvarchar(4000),
	[Value] float,
	[Currency] nvarchar(4000),
	[Quantity] float,
	[Unit of Measure] nvarchar(4000)
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'assignment/inventory.csv',
	DATA_SOURCE = [rawdata_storageblocks_dfs_core_windows_net],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat]
	)
GO


SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.test
GO
